using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync_LogsErrorOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup to throw exception to trigger catch block and LogError call
            migrateSession.SetupThrowOnReserve();

            // Act
            var result = await migrateSession.ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to reserve")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // Helper subclass to expose internals and inject behavior for testing
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            private readonly Mock<ILogger> _loggerMock;

            public TestableMigrateSession(ILogger logger)
            {
                _loggerMock = Mock.Get(logger);
                this.logger = logger;
                // Setup minimal required fields to avoid null refs
                _namespaces = new System.Collections.Generic.List<ulong> { 0, 1, 2, 3 };
                migrateOperation = new MigrateOperation[1];
                migrateOperation[0] = new MigrateOperationStub();
                _targetNodeId = 1234UL;
            }

            public void SetupThrowOnReserve()
            {
                ((MigrateOperationStub)migrateOperation[0]).ThrowOnExecute = true;
            }

            // Expose protected/internal fields for test
            public new ILogger logger;
            public new System.Collections.Generic.List<ulong> _namespaces;
            public new MigrateOperation[] migrateOperation;
            public new ulong _targetNodeId;

            // Stub class to simulate migrateOperation[0].Client.ExecuteForArrayAsync throwing
            private class MigrateOperationStub : MigrateOperation
            {
                public bool ThrowOnExecute { get; set; }

                public override Task<string[]> ExecuteForArrayAsync(params string[] args)
                {
                    if (ThrowOnExecute)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated failure");
                    return Task.FromResult(new string[0]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Minimal stub classes to satisfy references
        private abstract class MigrateOperation
        {
            public virtual Task<string[]> ExecuteForArrayAsync(params string[] args) => Task.FromResult(new string[0]);
            public object Client => this;
        }
    }
}

            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new MigrateSessionTestWrapper(loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await migrateSession.CallReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsyncWithException();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to reserve")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // Wrapper class to expose the internal method and simulate exception
        private class MigrateSessionTestWrapper : MigrateSession
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;

            public MigrateSessionTestWrapper(ILogger logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                this.logger = logger;

                // Setup minimal state to cause exception in ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync
                _namespaces = new System.Collections.Generic.List<ulong> { 0, 1, 2, 3 };
                migrateOperation = new MigrateOperationStub[1];
                migrateOperation[0] = new MigrateOperationStub(throwOnExecute: true);
                _targetNodeId = 42;
            }

            public async Task<bool> CallReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsyncWithException()
            {
                try
                {
                    return await base.ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync();
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Should not throw, but just in case
                    return false;
                }
            }

            // Stub class to simulate migrateOperation[0].Client.ExecuteForArrayAsync throwing
            private class MigrateOperationStub : MigrateOperation
            {
                private readonly bool _throwOnExecute;

                public MigrateOperationStub(bool throwOnExecute)
                {
                    _throwOnExecute = throwOnExecute;
                }

                public override Task<string[]> ExecuteForArrayAsync(params string[] args)
                {
                    if (_throwOnExecute)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated failure");
                    return Task.FromResult(Array.Empty<string>());
                }
            }
        }
    }
